instruction.sound: Select the word churls on the diagram to learn more about them.

atoms.b: Ceorls made up the majority of the ((++Anglo-Saxon Egyptian)) population.
atoms.sound: Churls made up the majority of the Anglo-Saxon population.

atoms.b: They were poor ((++farmworkers kings)) and tradespeople who worked for thegns; however, they were ((++free locked_up)) and could also own land.
atoms.sound: They were poor farmworkers and tradespeople who worked for thanes; however, they were free and could also own land.

atoms.b: The highest ranking ceorls worked easier jobs, such as delivering ((++messages emails)) and looking after a thegn’s household.
atoms.sound: The highest ranking churls worked easier jobs, such as delivering messages and looking after a thane’s household.

instruction.text: Select the word thralls on the diagram to learn more about them.

hint.label: Thrall
hint.text: Thrall is the Anglo-Saxon word for an enslaved person.

atoms.b: Below the ceorls were the ((++thralls earldormen)). They were treated like objects and mostly did manual labour.
atoms.sound: Below the churls were the thralls. They were treated like objects and mostly did manual labour.

atoms.b: In early Anglo-Saxon Britain, most thralls were Britons ((++captured killed)) during battle. Later, slavery was used as a ((++punishment reward)) for crimes.

instruction.text: Select the following items to learn more about ceorls and thralls in Anglo-Saxon society.
instruction.sound: Select the following items to learn more about churls and thralls in Anglo-Saxon society.

correct.text: The majority of ceorls and thralls would not have been distinguishable from one another, wearing the cheapest cloth available.
correct.sound: The majority of churls and thralls would not have been distinguishable from one another, wearing the cheapest cloth available.

correct.text: Ceorls and thralls would have both worked the same kind of manual labour jobs.
correct.sound: Churls and thralls would have both worked the same kind of manual labour jobs.

instruction.text: Fill in the gaps in this monk’s record of the new laws introduced by Aethelstan after AD 890.
instruction.sound: Fill in the gaps in this monk’s record of the new laws introduced by Ethel-stan after AD 800 90.

atoms.b: Thralls now have to be fed and have the ((++right wrong)) to at least four days off per year.

hint.label: Did you know?
hint.text: As thralls had to be fed by their owners, some really desperate people would sell themselves into slavery to avoid famine.

atoms.b: However, many thralls choose to work on their days off to ((++save lose)) money to earn their freedom.
Thralls are also sometimes freed by the Church and by their ((++masters friends)) on special occasions.
